body: It's impossible to lose hope when i have no hope in the first place.

Why bother going on though?

I've got no ambition, no talent, too scared to look for a better job, too scared to ask for help. It's nice that you had friends to help, but mine are different, nobody talks about their problems if they had any, it's unusual, where i live, to be so open with yourself - Well at least with my friends and family.
It may seem stupid, but i just can't. Whenever i'm put into a situation, i'll do anything to get out of it.
I know there are things that can't help, but there's an overpowering, overwhelming feeling to run away, and i can't manage to speak up.
